title: Power BI & Data Analyst Consultant
description:
#### **Work Location:** **Bangalore**

### **Objective**

Operates at the intersection of Business Intelligence and Systems Discovery—architecting enterprise semantic structures, drilling down into pipeline bugs, and advising development squads on data availability.

### **Internal Alignment**

Resource will be taking the ownership of Power BI enhancements, UX changes and also will be aligned with the Discovery team providing the technical support in terms of data exploration, investigations, exploration and supporting discovery team in term of documentations and day to day activities working under Discovery lead .

### **Technical Skills & Competencies**

* PowerBI & DAX: Advanced expertise in dashboard composition, custom report generation, calculation metric tuning through DAX, and setting row-level security parameters.
* Structured Data Modelling: Comprehensive grasp of enterprise-scale dimensional modelling paradigms (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema), relationship constraints, and optimization of staging layer performance.
* Exploratory SQL Proficiency: Robust capabilities utilizing SQL queries for querying complex repositories, validating transformation accuracy, and mapping table relationships.
* Technical Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Systematic skill in tracking technical defects, identifying anomalies, and running diagnostics across broken models or reporting layers.
* Technical Discovery Architecture: Proven experience exploring new data sets, validating structural integrity, and producing design summaries that assist development cohorts during engineering readiness.

### **Soft Skills Needed**

* Analytical Curiosity & Diagnostic Mindset: An inherent drive to dig deeper than superficial dashboard bugs to isolate exact core flaws and systemic discrepancies.
* Consultative Communication: Exceptional capability to convert complex, technical discoveries into actionable, clear executive summaries for both engineers and project stakeholders.
* Collaborative Leadership: Comfort stepping up as a direct guide for developers to ensure engineering efforts remain aligned with actual business intelligence requirements.

title: Intern - CI&A Data Analyst
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Commercial at Lilly, Bengaluru
  
The medicines Lilly develops only reach patients if the commercial engine behind them works with precision. At Lilly in Bengaluru, the commercial function builds and powers that engine, designing the capabilities, generating the intelligence, and developing the strategies that Lilly's customer-facing teams around the world depend on to connect medicines to the people who need them. The work here is not local in scope. It shapes how Lilly operates commercially across geographies, business units, and markets globally.
  
  
Job Description- Customer Insights & Analytics
  
The purpose of the LCCI Customer Insights & Analytics team is to partner with US Customer Insights & Analytics in providing high quality analytical support to Brand, Market Research and other internal partners through right data, smart analytics and actionable insights.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Develop familiarity with commercial data sources and access and build governed

datasets via Gold Layer / semantic layer assets in Databricks Unity Catalog.
  

* Deliver high-quality analytical outputs across the commercial value chain — patient journey, segmentation, targeting, channel spend, and persistency — translating findings into clear business insights and recommendations for brand and commercial teams.
* Build and maintain performance dashboards and reports covering brand performance, market monitoring, launch trackers, and KAM/Institutional analytics using Power BI.
* Apply Generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) to accelerate analysis, draft insight summaries, and explore agentic approaches to automate routine reporting tasks.
* Query Gold Layer metric views using SQL and Python in Databricks notebooks to

support consistent, governed analytics across brand and commercial use cases.
  

* Leverage Generative AI tools and agentic workflows to automate routine reporting, simplify data summarization, and accelerate delivery of analytical insights to

stakeholders.
  

* Participate in stakeholder meetings, contribute to presenting outputs and

recommendations, and help translate analytical findings into actionable business decisions.
  
  
Education Requirements
  

* Degree in quantitative discipline i.e. Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Engineering or Computer Sciences from Tier-I institute.

Job Location
  
Bengaluru
  
  
What we look for
  

* Ability to think strategically in an ambiguous environment in analytics
* Technical Skills
* Strong Problem-solving skills
* Advanced MS-office skills (MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint)
* Experience in SQL (preferred)
* Experience in data visualization tools e.g. PowerBI (preferred)

* Strong work ethic and personal motivation

description:

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled **IT Analyst Applications** to join **Strategic Procurement** -**CAT IT Division.**

The preference for this role is to be based out of **Whitefield PSN Office -Bangalore, KA-India**

**What you will do**

**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a skilled IT Analyst – Data & Integration to support the Strategic Procurement & Planning division.
* This role will act as a key bridge between business partners and technology teams, delivering scalable, data-driven solutions across Power BI, the Enterprise Procurement Data Platform, and our procurement application portfolio.
* The ideal candidate combines strong Power BI expertise, data engineering and analytics capabilities, system integration experience, and business analysis skills to translate business needs into impactful technology solutions.

**Business Engagement & Delivery**

* Partner directly with Strategic Procurement & Planning stakeholders to understand business needs. Translate business requirements into technical solutions, dashboards, and integration designs. Act as a trusted advisor and ensure delivery of measurable business value.

**Power BI & Data Visualization**

* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards. Build and optimize data models, DAX, and Power Query transformations. Enable self-service analytics and ensure performance and scalability.

**Data Analysis & Engineering**

* Analyze complex datasets, identify trends, and design ETL/ELT pipelines. Support enterprise data platform and ensure data quality and governance.

**System Integration & Application Support**

* Design and implement integrations using APIs, ETL tools, and middleware. Support data exchange across enterprise systems and ensure reliability and security.

**Business Analysis & Requirements**

* Elicit and document requirements, perform gap analysis, and ensure alignment between business needs and technical delivery.

**What you will have**

* Power BI, data engineering concepts, SQL/Python, system integration, strong business analysis and stakeholder communication skills.

**Success Measures**

* Trusted by business partners, delivers impactful dashboards, improves system integration, and enhances procurement analytics capabilities.

* Experience with enterprise data platforms, procurement processes, procurement applications, and data governance.
* **This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office**

**Skills desired:**

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

  
**Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

  
**Application Design, Architecture:** Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
Level Extensive Experience:  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

**Implementation:** Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
**Requirements Analysis:** Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

  
**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

  
**System Testing:** Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
Level Working Knowledge:  

* Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
* Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
* Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
* Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
* Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

title: Advanced Business Analyst I- Veeva Safety
description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department:** Veeva Platform Management & Safety Solutions, Global Business Services (GBS), Enterprise IT & Quality

**Location:** Global Business Services (GBS), Bangalore, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Advanced Business Analyst 1, you will be the day-to-day analytical, technical and process partner to the System Manager for Veeva Safety. You will turn business requirements into technical Veeva designs, keep changes, releases and validation compliant and on time, and resolve data transmission issues with interfacing systems. Your work keeps a GxP-critical safety system reliable and improving, so safety and pharmacovigilance colleagues worldwide can depend on it every day.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You combine strong techno-functional knowledge of Veeva Safety with hands-on experience of keeping GxP-critical systems compliant and running well. You will also bring:

* An MCA, MTech, BCA or similar graduate degree in a relevant field, or other relevant business experience.
* 6+ years in IT, including at least 4 years in GxP system operations applying ITIL principles.
* Strong techno-functional knowledge of Veeva Safety and a sound understanding of the safety or pharmacovigilance domain.
* Experience maintaining GxP-critical systems in an operational environment with a strong compliance focus, including supporting and presenting during audits and inspections.
* Release management experience, from planning and execution to benefit realisation.
* Vendor management experience in an international matrix organisation, coordinating with external partners and stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to communicate with vendors, consultants and, potentially, customers and authorities.
* A structured, business-oriented, outgoing and flexible way of working, with full ownership of your tasks and a natural team spirit.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Broader knowledge of the Veeva platform and/or related systems.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will support the Veeva Safety team across system, change and release management, validation and compliance. This is an individual contributor role: you will work independently within defined guidelines, with guidance on the most complex assignments. You will:

* Lead engagements between business users and IT development teams, gathering and analysing complex requirements, defining scope and objectives, and translating needs into technical Veeva Safety designs.
* Recommend improvements to business processes and the system, and document how application components relate to each other.
* Deliver system and support services with the System Manager, including system releases and the Validation Responsible role for change requests, in line with change management procedures.
* Coordinate and resolve data transmission issues between Veeva Safety and its interfacing systems.
* Handle audit findings and corrective and preventive actions on time, contribute to annual periodic reviews, and support the system during internal and external audits and inspections.
* Create and review system documentation according to SOPs, applying lean and agile ways of working to keep processes simple and efficient.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Veeva Platform Management & Safety Solutions team in Global Business Services, part of Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

Your closest partner will be the System Manager for Veeva Safety. You will also work with the System Owner, Project Owners, your Department Manager, IT and business subject matter experts, IT QA/QC and business QA colleagues, the system vendor and project team members in Denmark.

Together, you will solve issues, discuss change requests and plan upgrades. You will work with IT QA/QC on leaner processes and documentation, and stay close to the vendor on evolving technology. Planning and prioritising across units keeps the work moving when demand shifts.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will take real ownership of a GxP-critical system, trusted to manage your own planning and deliverables. You will be encouraged to speak up, identify better practices and share them across units, and bring new ideas from the wider technology landscape into how the system develops.

Working with business, quality and vendor colleagues across geographies, you will deepen your Veeva expertise and your understanding of the safety business, holding high standards for quality and compliance while finding simpler, faster ways to work.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to keep Veeva Safety compliant, reliable and improving for colleagues around the world, apply for the Advanced Business Analyst 1 role by 27 October 2026.

**Location:** Bangalore

**Work Mode:** Hybrid (3 days)

**Application Deadline**- 28 October 2026

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Sr Business Analyst I- SAP EPPM Specialist and Delivery Lead
description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department:** SAP Finance Solutions, Enterprise IT & Quality

**Location:** Global Business Services (GBS), Bangalore, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As an SAP EPPM Functional Specialist and Delivery Lead, you will own the SAP Enterprise Portfolio and Project Management domain for Novo from project implementation through ongoing operations. Acting as the functional specialist and delivery lead, you will work closely with implementation partners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to design and deploy solutions on SAP S/4HANA. You will also be responsible for post-go-live support, service delivery, capacity and demand management discussions, stakeholder engagement, and continuous enhancement implementations for the EPPM landscape to meet evolving business needs.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You are a hands-on SAP expert who enjoys owning both the build and the run. You will bring:

* 8–10 years of relevant SAP experience, with strong functional expertise in SAP EPPM, PPM and Project System (PS).
* At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation, including hands-on Greenfield or Brownfield work for EPPM and PS, plus experience in support, rollout, upgrade or transformation programmes.
* Strong configuration experience across PPM, PS and Commercial Project Management (CPM), and their integration with FI/CO, MM, procurement and connected applications.
* Working knowledge of core SAP FI/CO processes and configuration, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable and Receivable, Asset Accounting, cost centre and internal order accounting, and period-end close.
* Experience in a service-level-based organisation, with responsibility for incidents, changes, operational stability and vendor coordination.
* A solid grasp of implementation methodologies, delivery governance, estimation, capacity planning, testing and release management.
* A track record of delivering high-quality outcomes under tight timelines in business-facing roles, and of resolving complex functional issues in a structured, sustainable way.
* Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to engage independently with business, IT and vendor stakeholders.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business administration or a related discipline.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* SAP certification in PS, EPPM or a related S/4HANA area.
* Domain experience in engineering, construction, IT services, manufacturing or another project-driven environment.
* Experience with LSMW, BDC and S/4HANA data-migration approaches, and ABAP debugging knowledge to speed up issue resolution with technical teams.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will hold long-term accountability for the SAP EPPM domain, balancing stable operations with predictable enhancement delivery and measurable business value. You will:

* Design, configure and optimise SAP S/4HANA PPM, PS and CPM – from project structures, WBS, networks, milestones and phase approvals to portfolio items, decision points, budgeting, availability control, settlement and financial KPIs.
* Keep Run-the-Core stable by leading incident resolution, root-cause and problem management, monitoring of batches and interfaces, and preventive improvements.
* Turn prioritised demand into clear delivery plans and drive the full lifecycle – requirements, design, configuration, testing, UAT support, deployment, hypercare and documentation – with changes managed through to closure under the right controls.
* Support integrations across PPM, PS, CPM, FI/CO, MM, procurement and reporting, and carry out core FI/CO functional work, including period-end processes.
* Lead vendor onboarding, work allocation and performance, and build dashboards that give visibility of KPIs, project status, risks, capacity and operational health.
* Build lasting capability through training, workshops and knowledge transfer, while ensuring alignment with SAP best practice, Clean Core principles, data quality, security, audit and compliance requirements.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join SAP Finance Solutions, the team that supports Novo’s end-to-end finance and enterprise project management processes. In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology and high quality.

Based in GBS Bangalore, you will work daily with onshore colleagues and global business partners. Product Architects will be your partners in making sure designs are scalable and Clean Core compliant before build. With the IT Product Owner, Process Leads and business stakeholders, you will align priorities and governance through the relevant SAPeco forums. You will also work closely with technical teams and delivery partners – setting clear expectations so work moves at pace.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will join a team with an enterprise mindset, focused on scalable, long-term solutions that benefit the whole organisation. Psychological safety is central to how the team works: a trust-based culture that encourages open dialogue, learning and strong performance.

You will be trusted to own a domain, make your voice heard and act decisively when things stall. Working across finance, project management, integration and vendor delivery, you will broaden your expertise and grow alongside colleagues in India and abroad.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own the SAP EPPM domain and keep projects across Novo moving with clarity, apply for the SAP EPPM Specialist and Delivery Lead role by 27 October 2026.

**Location:** Bangalore

**Work Mode:** Hybrid (3 days)

**Application Deadline**- 27 October 2026

title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
### **Data Quality Analyst**

* JR-163977
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* General Management

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

Position Summary

The Data Quality Analyst supports the Enterprise Data and Analytics Data Governance organization in maintaining high-quality, trusted data across key systems. This role assists with data quality monitoring, issue investigation, documentation, and the execution of data governance processes. The analyst works closely with senior team members, data stewards, and data owners to ensure data quality standards are followed, and issues are resolved in a timely manner.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

Data Quality Governance

Purpose: Support the establishment and maintenance of Data Quality (DQ) rules, standards, and processes to ensure high-quality, trusted data across the organization.

Create and Maintain Data Quality Rules and Standards

* Help update and maintain data quality rules (DQ FRD), metadata, and standards across data domains
* Support senior analysts in gathering requirements from data owners and stewards
  

  

Ensure Regulatory and Organizational Compliance

* Work with the Data Governance (DG) team and system owners to ensure rules and processes meet internal policies and standards
* Help validate consistency of DQ rules across Source Systems (SORs)
* Help monitor and report Data Quality Metrics and Thresholds
* Assist data owners and stewards in defining measurable DQ metrics and thresholds
* Help document KPIs and maintain metadata repositories
  

  

Recommend and Implement DQ Process Improvements

* Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to streamline Data Quality workflows and improve governance maturity
* Support Data Cleansing and Enrichment for LTC Migration
* Assist in executing cleansing and enrichment tasks as part of the LTC Account and Contact Data Migration
* Perform data validation, profiling, and documentation activities under guidance
  

  

Manage Change Control for DQ Rules and Business Glossary

* Assist in managing version control for DQ rules, definitions, and glossary updates
* Document changes and ensure proper review and approval processes are followed
  

  

Data Quality Monitoring & Reporting

* Assist with running automated data quality checks and reviewing results
* Support dashboard updates by providing data extracts, validation checks, and documentation
* Monitor DQ rule results and highlight anomalies or trends to senior analysts
* Help document and track data quality issues, remediation steps, and root-cause insights
* Collaborate with data owners and stewards to gather information needed for issue investigation and resolution
* Prepare initial drafts of DQ reports or summaries for review
* Support Data quality alignment activities with the GMPO Data Quality team
* Learn and apply data quality best practices through hands-on work and mentorship
  

  

**Qualifications**

Required Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related field
* 1–2 years of experience in Data Quality, Data Analytics, or related work (internships and academic projects acceptable)
* Basic SQL skills and willingness to grow technical proficiency
* Familiarity with or exposure to data quality concepts, dashboards, or rule-based validations
* Ability to analyze datasets, identify issues, and communicate findings clearly
* Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and eagerness to learn
* Good communication and collaboration skills
  

  

Preferred Certifications (Nice to Have, Not Required)

* Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Digital Leader, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals)
* Introductory SQL certifications (e.g., Microsoft DP-900, Google BigQuery SQL)
* Entry-level Data Governance or CDMP Associate certification
* Exposure to any data quality tools (Informatica DQ, Talend, Collibra DQ, etc.)

title: Global Size Merchandising Analyst
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

Within Center Demand planning, the Global Size Analytics team is dedicated to understanding product selling at the size level across all brands, categories, genders, channels, and customers. Given the size-intensive nature of the product we sell and the complex network of points of sale, understanding our performance at a size and store level is important to the success of Levi Strauss & Co. The Size Planning team works cross-functionally and is driven by data to build accurate size profiles and size strategies to maximize revenues through optimized investment.

The Global Size Analyst is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of size activations across global affiliates and channels. Working within the Sizing Process Optimization pillar, this role manages PC9/PC13 adoption in PLM and SAP systems, ensures alignment with approved size grid strategies, and partners cross-functionally to deliver end-to-end size activation across pre-season, in-season, and chase cycles. The Analyst combines strong technical expertise with structured process thinking to drive efficiency, data visibility, and continuous improvement across sizing operations.

**About the Job**

**Sizing Activation Execution:**

* Execute PC9/PC13 adoption and activation in PLM, aligned with the approved size grid by affiliate and channel.
* Ensure timely and accurate size activation using manual activation, RPA upload templates and other automation tools.
* Collaborate with Merchandising, Planning, and Sizing teams to deliver end-to-end size activation across pre-season, in-season, and chase products.

**Data Analysis & Reporting:**

* Extract, validate, and consolidate data from multiple systems to monitor activation status and track execution progress.
* Identify gaps or issues and escalate or resolve as appropriate
* Develop dashboards and reports to give stakeholders clear, timely visibility into size activation performance and status.

**Cross-Functional Coordination:**

* Align size activation activities and timelines with the Go-To-Market (GTM) process and key planning milestones.
* Communicate critical deliverables, timelines, and dependencies to cross-functional partners.
* Follow up proactively with internal and external teams to ensure alignment and on-time execution.

**Systems, Tools, and Process Improvement:**

* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for size activation tools and systems, including PLM and SGMT.
* Partner with IT (Support, RPA) to troubleshoot and resolve system and process issues.
* Design and build Python-powered or Excel-based tools to automate operational workflows and improve cross-functional access to size profile and activation data.
* Identify and recommend tools & process improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

**Business Support and Ad Hoc Requests:**

* Respond promptly to ad-hoc size activation requests and urgent business needs, including chase products and last-minute system updates
* Ensure fast and accurate execution under time sensitive conditions.

**Training and Enablement:**

* Train internal teams and stakeholders on sizing tools (PLM, SGMT) and related processes.
* Provide ongoing guidance to drive consistent and effective system usage across the organization.

**About You**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field.

**Experience:** 4+ years experience in, merchandising operations, size activation, or a similar role within the retail or apparel industry.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complex problems
* Ability to prioritize and multi-task various responsibilities
* Independently work on issue resolution and enhancements to existing solutions
* Strong customer focus and ability to collaborate with cross functional teams

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

**About the job**
-----------------

As an Agentic Data Cloud Customer Engineer, you are the premier technical subject matter expert in your territory. You will partner with Sales Specialists to execute the technical pre-sales strategy for customers, serving as the trusted technical advisor to CDOs, CTOs, Lead Architects, and developers. You will lead proactive discoveries to map complex, legacy customer data estates and qualify them for migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

You are a builder and architect that designs, codes, and deploys production-grade, end-to-end Data + AI pipelines that solve real-world enterprise problems. You will whiteboard modern open lakehouse architectures and run code demonstrations showing how unified data foundations power deterministic, hallucination-free conversational AI.

Leveraging a background in value-selling, you will conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership analyses and optimize architectures to prevent runaway spend. You will help customers adopt modern data engineering practices that securely unify data, analytics, and AI. If you possess deep expertise in Python, PySpark, and distributed data systems, and can translate technical excellence into business-transforming migrations, you will grow in this highly technical role.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define technical strategy for large accounts, engaging C-level executives via live demonstrations to solve business problems using the Agentic Data Cloud.
* Design, code, and deploy production-grade Data + AI pipelines (e.g., fraud detection, recommendation engines) and map legacy data estates to open-format architectures (Apache Iceberg).
* Orchestrate Intent-Driven data engineering to autonomously deploy PySpark pipelines using the Data Agent Kit, Antigravity, and Model Context Protocol.
* Lead high-impact showcases and technical value validations using BigQuery, Borderless Lakehouse, Knowledge Catalog, Spark, and Vertex AI to prove business outcomes.
* Conduct detailed Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses and optimize architectures (such as balancing DRAM/SSD, compute shapes, and token spend) to prevent runaway costs on the Lightning Engine.

description:
We are seeking a highly detail‑oriented Data Analyst to support the Strategic Growth Team (SGT), US, with executive‑level reporting, analytics, and opportunity review. This role is central to strengthening data quality, ensuring timely insights for senior leadership, and maintaining reporting accuracy that meets the expectations for executive consumption.

In addition to core reporting responsibilities, the analyst will assist with opportunity review during non‑peak reporting periods.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capability, impeccable attention to detail, and an excellent understanding of CRM/Sales systems, with proven experience in reporting for senior audiences.

This role will be based in the Noida/ Bengaluru office.

  

Executive Reporting & Analytics

* Develop, maintain, and deliver executive-level dashboards and reports with zero‑defect accuracy, supporting US leadership’s strategic decision‑making.
* Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, exceptions, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Validate weekly and monthly reporting inputs to ensure completeness and correctness, addressing the gaps previously observed in team reporting.
* Collaborate with SGT leaders to clarify reporting requirements and ensure output meets expectations.

Data Quality, Governance & System Support

* Conduct data audits, cleanse datasets, and troubleshoot discrepancies across system.
* Partner with technical teams to recommend improvements to data flows and business processes.
* Support review of missing or incorrect data fields in opportunities and take corrective actions aligned with Horizon standards.
* Assist with structural data requirements for new software tools and maintain accurate data models.

Opportunity Review

* Provide supplemental support for opportunity review during workload surges, ensuring SGT remains current on weekly pipelines as directed by leadership.
* Prioritize core reporting tasks before accepting additional intake—reflecting leadership’s requirement that reporting accuracy must not be compromised by backlog work.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

* Work closely with Horizon Sales Administrators and PMs.
* Proactively communicate blockers or data issues and recommend solutions for continuous improvement.
* Work with management to prioritize business and information needs and propose solutions and strategies to business challenges
* Analyze and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports
* Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and undertake pre-processing of structured and unstructured data
* “Clean” data by reviewing performance indicators to locate and correct code problems
* Create and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
* Analyse structural requirements and advise data architecture for new software and applications development by collaborating with engineering and product development teams
* Locate and define new process improvement opportunities and identify valuable data sources to automate collection processes
* Where essential, propose migration of data from legacy systems to new solutions
* Design conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts. Present information using data visualization techniques
* Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms

  

Key Competencies / Skills / Qualifications

Masters in Computer Science/Statistics/Maths/Information Technology

* Relevant domain certifications
* Proven work experience of 4-7 years as a Data Analyst or similar role
* Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques
* Strong experience with SQL, Python/R, Excel, and enterprise BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).

title: GTM Data Quality Analyst
description:
**Location**
------------

Bengaluru

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

Business Expansion

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You'll own the quality of the data that underpins every routing rule, territory, forecast and ARR number at CodeRabbit. You'll start by working the requests our GTM and Finance teams send to RevOps every day, and you'll turn each kind of request into a written runbook. Then you'll build the Data Quality Agent: an AI agent that handles most of those requests itself, routes the risky ones to a human for approval, and keeps a full record of everything it does. You'll join Business Systems, a small team that builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll work on the same engineering harness our engineers use to ship Salesforce and internal tool changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the tier-1 data queue for internal GTM systems data support: account ownership changes, account creation, merges, parent-child hierarchies, lead conversion, and linking billing subscriptions to the right Salesforce account.
* Resolve requests within the team's response standard and leave a record any teammate can pick up.
* Write and maintain a runbook for every recurring request type: the trigger, the checks, the steps, the edge cases, and when to escalate.
* Design, build and run the Data Quality Agent with Code Rabbit Coding Agent and our engineering harness, starting in shadow mode and earning its autonomy one workflow type at a time.
* Define the agent's approval tiers: what it can fix on its own, what it proposes for human approval, and what it always escalates.
* Run duplicate detection and merge cohorts across accounts, contacts and leads, and keep account hierarchies accurate as customers grow, merge and reorganize.
* Close enrichment gaps (firmographics, domains, HQ location, parent company) using our enrichment tools and the data warehouse.
* Track the request queue and data health with clear metrics: volume by request type, time to resolve, agent accuracy, and how often humans override the agent.
* Find the root cause behind repeat requests and bring proposals to the engineers so the fix lands upstream.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years in CRM data operations, sales operations, RevOps or data quality at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity data model, ownership and sharing basics, reports, and bulk data tools.
* Strong SQL. You can answer your own questions from the warehouse without waiting on an analyst.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate real work, and you can show us something you built: a prompt chain, a script, an agent, or an automation that saved hours.
* You write clear, step-by-step documentation that someone else can follow without asking you questions.
* Careful judgment with production data. You know which changes are easy to undo and which are not, and you treat them differently.
* Comfortable working across time zones with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dedupe and merge tools such as Traction Complete, DemandTools, Cloudingo or Salesforce duplicate rules.
* Python or JavaScript scripting, Git, and comfort working in a code repository.
* Experience with enrichment and prospecting data tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Exposure to billing systems such as Chargebee, and how subscriptions can map to CRM data.
* Experience with BigQuery, dbt or another cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows: approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logs and evaluations.
* Familiarity with developer-tools or technical B2B SaaS go-to-market (GTM).

**Our Values**
--------------

  

* **Collaborative Humans**: Prioritizing collective intelligence

* **Fearless Innovators**: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

* **Persistent, Passionate Developers**: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

* **Impact-Driven Creators**: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

* **Rapid Learners and Un-learners**: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

**What We Offer**
=================

  

* Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

* Collaborative and innovative environment

* Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

* Professional development opportunities

To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

title: Business Analytics Leader
description:
Bangalore Full-Time Senior

**About this role**
-------------------

Mission Brief: Be the Analytical Brain Beside Every Decision-Maker at Lenskart

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with Lenskart's functional leaders — the CEO, Business Heads, Supply Chain Head, Technology Head, and the leaders running our individual geographies — and turn data into the decisions that move the business forward.

  

You will not run a back-office reporting function. You will be a thinking partner in the room where strategy happens, translating the firehose of Lenskart's data into sharp, timely insight that changes what we do next. Your mandate is to make Lenskart's decision-making faster, sharper, and more AI-native than any retailer in the world.

  

The Context: Where Lenskart Already Is

You are not being asked to start from zero — you are being asked to take a fast-moving machine and accelerate it. Today at Lenskart, our meetings are transcribed and processed by our AI agents, our global technology and revenue roadmaps are part of the training context for our internal AI agents, and those agents already analyze weekly revenue trends on their own. Every Monday they surface what should be on the agenda for our weekly business reviews — what we're building, what's working, and what we're missing. Anonymized signals from Slack, email, and other communications flow into our analytics engine, which crisply summarizes the next steps for the organization.

  

That is the baseline. We are looking for someone who can natively operate in this environment and push it considerably further.

  

Core Mandate

1. Insight Partnership to Functional Leaders (The Decision Focus) Embed alongside the CEO, business heads, supply chain, technology, and geography leaders as their trusted analytics partner. Frame the right questions, pressure-test assumptions with data, and deliver the insight that drives concrete business decisions — pricing, assortment, expansion, capital allocation, and growth bets. Own the quality and speed of the insight that reaches the leadership table.

  

2. AI-First Transformation of Analytics & Decision-Making (The AI Focus) Be the fastest adopter — and the chief evangelist — of emerging AI tools, models, and analytics technologies across Lenskart. Reimagine how analysis itself is produced and consumed, moving the organization from dashboards-on-request toward autonomous, agent-driven insight. Set the standard for how decisions are made in an AI-native company and bring every function along with you.

  

3. Advancing Lenskart's AI & Analytics Systems (The Builder Focus) Take ownership of evolving our existing AI infrastructure — the meeting-intelligence pipelines, the roadmap-trained agents, the weekly revenue-trend analysis, and the communications summarization engine. Partner with Data Science and Engineering to extend these systems' reach, reliability, and sophistication, ensuring they remain a genuine competitive advantage rather than a novelty.

  

4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Adoption (The Culture Focus) Drive a data-and-AI-first decision-making culture across every function and geography. Challenge the status quo, raise the analytical bar of the leaders you support, and mentor a high-performing team of analysts who can operate at the pace of a high-growth global retailer.

  

The Essentials

Track Record: A strong record of partnering directly with senior executives and influencing material business decisions through analytics, data science, or strategy/decision-support work.

AI Fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on adoption of modern AI and analytics tooling (LLMs, agentic workflows, ML-driven forecasting and decision systems) — not as a spectator, but as an early and aggressive practitioner who has put these tools into real operational use.

Technical Acumen: Deep, practical command of analytics and data — SQL and modern data stacks, statistical and ML modeling, and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous, scalable analysis.

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a highly quantitative field — Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, or similar.

The Mindset

AI-Native by Default: You reach for AI to solve problems instinctively, you stay at the frontier of new tools, and you are energized by the idea of building a company where agents do the first draft of analysis and humans make sharper decisions because of it.

Executive Presence & Influence: You are a compelling communicator who can sit across from any functional leader, distill complexity into a clear recommendation, and earn the right to shape the decision.

Analytical Rigor & Speed: You thrive on data complexity and turn ambiguity into clear, profitable action at the pace of a high-growth tech company.

Builder's Bias: You see analytics as a living product and an evolving system — never finished, always being made faster and smarter.

Equinix is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Business Systems Analyst** to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.



You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.



The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.


### **Key Responsibilities**



 Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.

 Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.

 Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.



 Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.



 Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.



 Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.



 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.



 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.



 Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.

**About the Team**


The Inventory Replenishment \& Planning team ensures the right product, in the right quantity, in the right location, at the right time. It all starts with accurate sales forecasting. title: Sr. Manager/Manager - Supply Chain Analytics
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.
  
We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.
  
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.
  
We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
  
If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  

About Your Role at Lilly
  
At Lilly, every function has a role in getting medicines to patients.
  
Some build the science.
  
Others build the organisation that makes the science possible.
  
At Lilly in Bengaluru, the Supply Chain function is the infrastructure that allows scientists, engineers, and commercial professionals to do the work that reaches patients.
  
Your work is part of that chain.
  
  

Job Description
  
This role is part of the Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE), a global team that leverages advanced analytics capabilities to enable the achievement of Global Supply Chain (GSC) objectives.
  
  

This role will provide technical expertise across supply chain analytics, planning, and global logistics for manufacturing sites, affiliates, hubs, regions, and zones. Candidate requires a strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes combined with advanced analytical skills like statistical modelling, AI/ML and data engineering concepts.
  
  

This role will lead and deliver high\-impact projects that enhance operational efficiency and support data\-driven decision\-making across the global supply chain. Responsibilities include driving cross\-functional collaboration, managing stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks, and effectively communicating project status, milestones, and key deliverables.
  
  

This role also contributes to supply chain transformation initiatives including NexGen programs and works closely with GSC teams to streamline operations through analytics and automation.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide advanced analytical expertise to Global Supply Chain (GSC) stakeholders, with a strong focus on optimizing processes, systems, and tools used to manage products across complex supply networks.
* Design, develop, and deliver enterprise\-grade Power BI dashboards that enable real\-time visibility into key supply chain KPIs, including inventory health, service levels, and logistics performance across global operations.
* Translate complex and high\-volume supply chain data into clear, actionable insights, empowering stakeholders to make faster, data\-driven decisions.
* Enhance and modernize reporting solutions by improving data accuracy, usability, and self\-service capabilities — reducing manual effort while increasing stakeholder confidence and adoption.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and resolution of issues within reporting and analytics solutions to ensure reliability, continuity, and accuracy of business\-critical insights.
* Build and operationalize scalable ETL pipelines and robust semantic data models that integrate data across ERP, planning, and logistics systems.
* Support and contribute to strategic data initiatives, including EWM, TMS and Enterprise Data Lake (EDB), ensuring standardized, clean, and well\-governed data flows across platforms.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities for recurring and ad hoc data processes using tools such as Power Automate, Python, and SQL, reducing cycle time and manual dependencies.
* Act as the primary technical advisor to GSC stakeholders, providing guidance on supply chain systems, analytics tools, and end\-to\-end product flow management.
* Collaborate with global planners, operations teams, and IT partners to deliver cross\-functional analytics initiatives with measurable business impact.
* Proactively identify gaps in data, processes, and tools, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and performance across supply networks.
* Develop optimization models and scenario\-planning solutions to support strategic decision\-making across affiliates, distribution networks, and manufacturing sites.


Basic Qualifications
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Data Science, or a related field.


Experience
  
  

* 5–10 years in supply chain analytics, planning, or a related domain.


Language
  
  

* Proficiency in English (required).


Preferred Skills \& Experience
  
  

* Experience in Pharma / Life Sciences; manufacturing site exposure is a plus.
* APICS / CSCP certification preferred.
* Strong expertise in data visualization and transformation tools: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, Power Query.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP and planning systems: Kinaxis, SAP IBP, EWM, TMS.
* Advanced analytics skills using AI/ML, SQL, Python/R.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* High level of initiative, ownership, and ability to lead teams and manage ambiguity.


At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.
  
It is how we work.
  
We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.
  
This is not just a policy.
  
It is who we are.

title: Analyst-Market & Liquidity Risk
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.


With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.


Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**About the Role**

Position Title: **Market and Liquidity Risk Analyst**

Corporate Title: **Analyst**

Reporting to: **Senior analyst / VP / Director**

Location: Bengaluru


**Job Profile**

**Position details**

The role will be a hybrid role in market and liquidity risk management. Market risk management tasks will involve performing PnL and risk data generation and reporting, analysing and monitoring market risk activities undertaken by Global Markets (Trading) and Treasury (ALM). Liquidity risk management will mainly be enhancing Liquidity risk management practices and control functions for Asia branches.


This is a branch second line role, reporting into the regional market and liquidity risk management team overseeing and supporting Asia individual branches (ex. Japan and China) to uplift branch market and liquidity risk management. The person will be responsible for reporting, escalating and resolving risk related issues for local branch risk managers’ attention and support the local branch risk managers in carrying out their review and challenge function as a second line of defense in the bank.


The scope of products includes interest rate and FX related products such as interest rate swaps, FX swaps, CCS, Options, Bonds, on\-balance sheet loans, deposits and inter bank borrowing/lending.


**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Market Risk**

* Prepare daily, monthly and periodic risk reports and perform PnL, VaR and risk exposures analysis for the bank’s trading and treasury portfolio
* Monitor individual dealer’s position and PL and market risk greeks such as delta, PV01, gamma, vega, theta
* Perform market risk stress testing and daily VaR back\-testing and analysis
* Prepare and monitor various daily trade reconciliation and monitoring reports
* Capturing daily market data and ensuring integrity and accuracy of market data before uploading into front systems for day\-end revaluation process
* Monitor benchmark submissions (e.g. SOR, SORA for Singapore)
* Prepare daily market conduct check reports for the traders/dealers e.g. off\-price check;
* Monitor, investigate and report market risk limits and credit limits, along with Volcker rule metrics reporting and analysis for Volcker rule compliance
* Support Financial and Head Office reporting requirements

**Liquidity Risk**

* Prepare daily, monthly and other periodic risk reports for reporting to management.
* Prepare data and presentation materials for Asset Liability Management Committee meetings for Singapore and APAC including coordination with stakeholders for committee meetings.
* Regular monitoring including but not limited to liquidity risk indicators, balance sheet, Net Interest Income and stress testing.
* Maintain and improve the systems/infrastructures/EUCs (including update of policies and procedures) for funding liquidity Risk Management

**Second line for Market and Liquidity Risk Management will include but not limited to;**

* Under supervision and guidance from regional and branch risk management teams, support the preparation of materials for ALM/MRM Committee materials, Financial,Head Office and Regulatory reporting
* Work in collaboration with regional or local branch risk managers in handling requirements from internal/external audits and regulatory reviews and providing advisory for market and liqudity risk management activities to internal stakeholders including Global Markets, Treasury, Back\-office
* Work in close partnership with regional risk management team to support ongoing Head Office or regional projects related to market and liquidity risk, including ongoing efforts in process simplification and streamlining and implementation of industry best practices
* Prepare Asia branch specific local reporting for market and liquidity risk
* Performing other responsibilities or other adhoc projects as assigned from time to time

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or related field preferred
* Preferred MBA/CA
* At least 1 year experience in Banking/Treasury/Risk management is required
* Excellent oral and written communication in English
* Strong knowledge of Python and Excel VBA is required
* Good knowledge of Tableau or Alteryx will be advantageous
* Prior experience in process streamlining, automation and ability to conceptualise automated control solutions is preferred
* Good knowledge of banking and derivatives products is desirable
* Experience in ALM and funding risk management desirable
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment with a strong control mindset
* Takes initiatives to collaborate and challenge status quo, and adaptable to embrace new changes
* Strong communication skills (both verbal \& writing), interpersonal and business analytical skills attributes
* Self\-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and able to work independently to source for information, systematically evaluate options and recommend solutions
* Flexible team player and able to work and deliver under pressure

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long\-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

title: Data Engineering Analyst
description:
### **The Role**



Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture \& Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands\-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.



In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.



This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture \& Governance Manager for ISC.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
* Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current\-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
* Document current\-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy\-to\-cloud modernization.
* Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
* Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions.
* Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 3\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
* Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow
* Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data.
* Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze\-layer ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, communication, and self\-management skills.
* Experience working in cross\-functional or global teams.
* Google Cloud certifications are a plus.


*\**\*


**What You Will Bring**


* A hands\-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.
* Strong curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity in legacy environments.
* The ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
* A proactive, self\-directed approach to identifying priorities and driving work forward.
* A passion for building scalable, maintainable data solutions that support business value.

title: Analytics Engineering Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Analytics Engineering team for a 6\-month internship building the data foundation that powers business decisions, and the AI systems that make that data accessible to every analyst at EarnIn. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams \- data modeling and AI\-powered analytics\- under the guidance of senior analytics engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Contribute to the Agentic Analytics system, an AI agent that answers business questions by generating and evaluating SQL, by reviewing agent outputs for correctness, curating golden evaluation datasets, and capturing domain business rules that improve the agent's accuracy over time.
* Develop a deep understanding of EarnIn's core business domains to evaluate whether AI\-generated answers are correct for real business questions; your domain judgment is the most valuable input to the system.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real analytics engineering context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented SQL and Python code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers and analysts across the Data team; present your work and learnings to the broader team.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Experience with SQL \- writing queries, understanding data models, working with analytical datasets; coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with Python for data work; classroom or project experience is fine.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. This is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Curiosity about how businesses work \- you want to understand why a metric is defined a certain way, not just how to query it.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset \- you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly with moderate guidance.
* Prior internship or project experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, and/or business intelligence is a plus.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or dbt in any environment (coursework, personal project, or prior role) is a plus.
* Exposure to data modeling concepts or BI tools (Tableau or similar) is a plus


\#LI\-Hybrid

**Position Overview**
 Words With Friends Instant is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to be the analytics owner for the game: the person product, design, and engineering come to for data on player behavior, feature health, experimentation, and game strategy. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data\-driven insights.
   

  

**Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience**
* Product Strategy: Analyze long and short\-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
* Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
* Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance


**What You'll Do**
* Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
* Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with other disciplines to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders, translating complex analyses into clear decisions and influencing product and game strategy at the leadership level.
* Support the team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
* Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
* Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
* Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first\-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
* Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
* Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
* Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
* Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
* Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Demonstrated experience in data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
* Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
* Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
* Highly self\-motivated with a keen interest in problem\-solving.
* Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
* Strong communication skills \- you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus

 Experience in gaming, mobile, or consumer tech industries.
